About VoteX — Authentic, Secure Democracy

VoteX is an authentic digital civic election application built upon the principles of verifiable identity, cryptographic auditing, and complete public transparency. Every ballot is guaranteed to be one citizen, one voice, counted exactly as cast.

Why VoteX is Authentic & Trustworthy

Security measures engineered to eliminate voter fraud and protect election integrity

Certified Integrity
🪪

Aadhaar Identity Verification

Every voter registration requires a valid 12-digit Aadhaar identifier. Fictitious registrations, bots, and duplicate accounts are strictly prevented at registration.

🔒

Single Ballot Enforcement

Our database enforces atomic single-vote constraints. Once a voter submits their ballot, their profile is permanently sealed (isVoted = true), making multiple votes impossible.

📊

Live Public Auditing

Results and party tallies are streamed in real time directly from the database to this website. No secret counts, delayed disclosures, or hidden vote modifications.

🛡️

Admin Neutrality Lockdown

Election administrators have permissions to register and update candidate profiles, but the server strictly blocks administrators from voting.

🔐

Confidential & Encrypted

Passwords are salted and hashed using industry-standard bcrypt encryption. Your individual voting choice is protected and private.

✓

Zero Third-Party Tracking

VoteX operates without external tracking, commercial advertising, or third-party data sharing. Your personal data stays on the secure civic election node.

Frequently Asked Trust & Security Questions

Can someone vote twice using the same Aadhaar?

No. The system uses strict database uniqueness constraints on Aadhaar numbers and irreversibly marks the voter record as voted upon submission.

Can an administrator alter my vote?

No. Candidate votes are stored as permanent sub-document references and total counts are calculated mathematically by the database.

How do I know the election results are real?

Vote counts are queried live directly from the candidate collection in MongoDB. The live tally matches the total verified ballots submitted.

What if I need to change my vote?

To ensure zero election tampering and prevent coerced re-voting, a ballot is final and cannot be modified once confirmed.

Election Participation Rules

  • Single Ballot Integrity: Each verified Aadhaar identity is permitted to cast exactly one ballot.
  • Final Submission: Once a vote is submitted to the database, it cannot be modified or retracted.
  • Audited Results: Live tallies are compiled automatically based on confirmed ballots.
  • Role Distinction: Administrator accounts govern candidate registrations and are restricted from voting.
